title: Fixtures-script mkdir -p has no automated regression pin (P3 dev tooling)
evidence:
# fixtures/ is git-untracked, so a fresh checkout has no such directory —
# create it before cd or `set -e` aborts the run.
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"
cd "$(dirname "$0")/fixtures"
detail: No suite or CI step executes this script; verification was manual fresh-checkout sim. Blast radius is small: `set -e` makes any regression fail loudly at the next bug-hunt preflight, and the repo has no shell-test harness. Consistent with AGENTS.md named-regression philosophy.
recommended_fix: Optionally add a pr-checks smoke step running the script from a clean temp copy; otherwise rely on the loud `set -e` failure at next preflight.
